The '''Senate Unification Preparations Committee''' was a [[Galactic Alliance Senate]] committe whose purpose was to organize the preparations for the [[Unification Summit]], a series of negotiations in an attempt to unite the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances]], the [[Confederation]], and the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]]. The committee was headed by [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] Galactic Alliance [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Tiurrg Drey'lye]].

In [[43 ABY]], Drey'lye, escorted by [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]], met with Imperial Remnant [[Head of State/Legends|Head of State]] [[Jagged Fel]] in a preliminary meeting aboard the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] [[Gilad Pellaeon (starship)|''Gilad Pellaeon'']].
